criteria.requirement: Add pyparsing.byte_input.parse_bytes(expression,data,*,encoding,parse_all=False), immutable ByteParseResult(results,text,byte_offsets), and ByteParseError(error,byte_offset). Require bytes and explicit supported codec UTF8/UTF8-SIG/ASCII/Latin1, reject other/stateful encodings rather than guess. Map every character boundary and EOF to original bytes including BOM. Use top-level grammar copy with tabs preserved; original grammar policy stays unchanged. Propagate strict UnicodeDecodeError, wrap only real ParseBaseException with exact original byte offset, retain original exception and results.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
